fields.mechanism: degradation mechanisms and recent strategies for improving durability
fields.intervention: Implement advanced protective coatings and encapsulation materials similar to those used in semitransparent perovskite solar cells to create a thermal barrier around lithium battery cells
fields.expected_effect: The protective coating would contain thermal runaway events within individual battery cells, preventing propagation to adjacent cells and protecting surrounding components while maintaining minimal mass/volume penalties
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated aging tests under extreme temperature conditions followed by thermal abuse tests to verify containment of thermal events within the battery envelope
fields.mechanism_source_span: degradation mechanisms and recent strategies for improving their durability

fields.mechanism: Semitransparent perovskite solar cells with optimized balance between efficiency and optical transparency
fields.intervention: Apply semitransparent perovskite material as a thermal management layer in lithium battery installations
fields.expected_effect: The semitransparent layer would allow heat dissipation while containing thermal events within the battery envelope
fields.falsification_test: Simulate battery thermal runaway conditions with and without the perovskite layer to measure containment effectiveness and heat dissipation rates
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Advancing this technology requires deeper understanding of its design principles, applications, economic viability, and performance limitations. Therefore, this review examines key strategies for achieving an optimal balance between efficiency and optical transparency in ST-PSCs across small-, large-scale, and flexible devices, with emphasis on the functional roles and optimization approaches of individual components."
